# BoomNetwork

> Unity multiplayer frame-sync networking framework — C# client + Go server.
> Self-authority model: your input = zero-latency truth, no prediction, no rollback.

## Docs

- [Full API Reference for LLMs](llms-full.txt): Complete class/method/event listing with code templates
- [Quick Start](doc/shared/03-quickstart.md): Project structure and setup
- [Core Philosophy](doc/shared/04-core-philosophy.md): Three axioms of self-authority
- [API Reference](doc/client/01-api-reference.md): Detailed client API
- [Architecture](doc/shared/07-architecture.md): System overview
- [Local-First Pattern](doc/shared/08-local-first-pattern.md): The OnFrame contract
- [Entity Authority Sync](doc/design/entity-authority-sync.md): Dead Reckoning + Inertia model
- [Server Deployment](doc/server/01-deployment.md): Docker / systemd / binary

## Core Philosophy (Three Axioms)

1. **Self-authority** — Each player owns their character. Own input executes instantly, no server confirmation needed.
2. **Trust and smooth** — Remote state is trusted directly, smoothed visually via interpolation/extrapolation.
3. **Arbitrator settles conflicts** — One ruling (host or server), no rollback. At most a visual correction.

## Design Red Lines (MUST follow when generating code)

1. **No rollback in core** — Never import or reference prediction/rollback concepts.
2. **Zero-latency own input** — Own input executes immediately in the game loop, NOT inside OnFrame.
3. **Local-First OnFrame** — Inside OnFrame, SKIP the local player's input (already executed locally).
4. **Silent When Idle** — Only call SendInput when the player has actual input. Never send empty input every frame.
5. **Deterministic OnFrame** — All shared game state changes MUST happen inside OnFrame. No async mutations.

## Minimal Example (Plain C#)

```csharp
var client = new FrameSyncClient(heartbeatIntervalMs: 3000, heartbeatTimeoutMs: 10000);

client.OnConnected      += () => client.MatchRoom(maxPlayers: 4);
client.OnReady          += () => client.RequestStart();
client.OnFrame          += frame => {
    foreach (var input in frame.Inputs)
        if (input.PlayerId != client.PlayerId)  // Local-First: skip own
            ApplyInput(input.PlayerId, input.DataSpan);
};

client.Connect("127.0.0.1", 9000);

// Game loop
void Update(float dtMs) {
    client.Tick(dtMs);
    if (client.CurrentState == FrameSyncClient.State.Syncing && HasInput()) {
        byte[] input = BuildInput();
        client.SendInput(input);   // send to server
        ApplyInput(client.PlayerId, input);  // execute locally NOW (zero latency)
    }
}
```

## Minimal Example (Unity — BoomNetworkManager)

```csharp
// Add BoomNetworkManager to a GameObject, set host/port in Inspector
[RequireComponent(typeof(BoomNetworkManager))]
public class MyGame : MonoBehaviour {
    BoomNetworkManager _net;
    void Start() {
        _net = GetComponent<BoomNetworkManager>();
        _net.Client.OnFrame += OnFrame;
        _net.QuickStart();  // Connect → MatchRoom → RequestStart
    }
    void Update() {
        if (_net.IsSyncing && HasInput()) {
            byte[] input = BuildInput();
            _net.SendInput(input);
            ApplyLocalInput(input);
        }
    }
    void OnFrame(FrameData frame) {
        foreach (var inp in frame.Inputs)
            if (inp.PlayerId != _net.PlayerId) ApplyInput(inp);
    }
}
```

## Server Startup

```bash
cd svr && go run ./cmd/framesync/ -config cmd/framesync/config.yaml
# Or with Docker:
docker run -p 9000:9000 -p 9091:9091 boomnetwork/server
```

## Three Sync Modes

| Mode | Use Case | Start Frame Sync? | Key Methods |
|------|----------|-------------------|-------------|
| **Frame Sync** | Action/MOBA/survival | Yes (RequestStart) | SendInput, OnFrame |
| **Entity Authority** | Open world/racing | Yes | RegisterAuthorityEntity, OnEntityState |
| **State Sync** | Social/casual/chat | No | SendStateMessage, SetData, OnStateMessage |

## Package Install (Unity)

```json
// Packages/manifest.json
"com.boom.boomnetwork": "https://github.com/luwenyiCC/BoomNetwork.git?path=unity/com.boom.boomnetwork#dev1.0"
```
